name: Awakening
overview: Scripture calls believers to spiritual awakening, urging them to rise from sin and complacency as seen in Isaiah's call for Zion to 'awake' and clothe herself in strength and holiness. This awakening is rooted in the eternal Word of God, who was with God from the beginning and through whom life and light come. Jesus, the Word made flesh, speaks of awakening Lazarus from death, symbolizing the power He has to bring spiritual life. Believers are encouraged to walk away from ungodliness and are promised a future awakening to eternal life when Christ returns to receive His own.
